items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mary; the interviewer identifies Mary as the source of the information ('That was by- she was by Mary. Yes, that would be by Mary.'), implying the interviewee knows of her only through this context or general acquaintance, with no personal interaction described.

ctx.x: My aunts, you know, my uncle's wives. I have one aunt that's living in Berkeley, California, where my uncle Gus just died here about three years ago, and she's nearly 80 herself. Yeah.
That was by- she was by Mary. Yes, that would be by Mary.

His name is Monette, and- Yes, August Monette has 21 children by one woman. Oh, really? What is his name? August Monette. My mother's second- my mother's third brother. My mother's second- the third child's second brother. Yeah. And then I have another- my other uncle, my godfather's name Neville, Ned Monette. Yeah. N-V-I-L-L-E. Yes. And he had two children. And my aunt had six boys, and she had a little girl, the one that died recently. But she was seven to eight years old when she died.
